description: One US airport (airport=SFO required): FAA delay/closure events plus current NOAA weather and NWS alerts. Not for navigation. Not endorsed by the FAA or NOAA. Price: 30 sats (Lightning) or $0.025 USDC on Base (x402). Sample (illustrative, not live): {"status":"success","endpoint":"travel_airport","data":{"coverage":"us","source":"faa_nas_status","airport":{"iata":"SFO","icao":"KSFO","name":"San Francisco Intl","state":"CA","lat":37.6188,"lon":-122.375},"delays":{"has_published_event":true,"events":[{"airport":"SFO","type":"ground_delay","reason":"wind"}]},"weather":{"conditions":{"text":"Windy","temperature_f":58.0}},"alerts":{"coverage":"us","source":"noaa_nws","count":0,"alerts":[]},"not_for_navigation":true},"metadata":{"cost_sats":30}} Pay: Call it, get HTTP 402 (or MCP payment_required) with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pay the invoice, then retry with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Or pay in USDC on Base via x402: sign the 402's x402 requirement (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, or `accepts` in the JSON body) and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) header; only a 200 is settled.

airport.description: US airport IATA (SFO) or ICAO (KSFO) code. Required for get_travel_airport; optional filter for get_airport_delays.

l402_credential.description: Optional L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (or 'L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>') from a paid invoice or an active subscription. Omit it to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

x402_payment.description: Optional x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload (v2, or v1 X-PAYMENT format) signed for accepts[0] of this tool's payment_required result. Alternative to params._meta['x402/payment']. Omit both to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_travel_airport
title: Travel airport (30 sats L402 or $0.025 USDC x402)
